title: Codex CLI goes fullscreen
description: Why Codex owns the terminal in long sessions, how copying changes, and how to switch back.
author: Codex team
coverAlt: A terminal with earlier history above it and a composer pinned at the bottom.

hero.alt: Codex pages back through a long session with the composer pinned, then jumps to the latest message.
hero.caption: Scrolling through a saved example session; the composer stays in place.

copy.alt: A paragraph and code are selected in Codex and the formatted text appears on paste.
copy.caption: Copy-on-select with prose and code. The example session is synthetic; the selection is made in Codex.

side.alt: A side conversation beside the parent, with independent composers.
side.caption: Preview of /side in development. The split requires at least 145 columns.
